entry.title: Allianza: The Bridge-Free Architecture and Quantum Redundancy (QRS-3)
entry.summary: Hello, developer community! I am part of the team developing the Allianza Blockchain. DEV.to is the perfect place for us to dive into technical details, and that's exactly what we'll do. Allianza was designed to solve two of the biggest infrastructure challenges in Web3: secure interoperability and quantum resistance. Bridge-Free Interoperability The model of custodial cross-chain bridges is the weak point of current security. To overcome this, we developed the ALZ-NIEV Protocol. The ALZ-NIEV does not use intermediary custody. Instead, it uses Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZK) to perform Native Signature Validation. How does it work? Real Post-Quantum Security: QRS-3 The threat of quantum computing is real and imminent. Allianza implemented QRS-3 (Triple Quantum Protection), a system of Triple Structural Redundancy. QRS-3 combines three different cryptographic structures to ensure that even if one is broken, the other two maintain security. Algorithm Validation requires 2 out of 3 signatures, ensuring that security does not depend on a single mathematical failure. Conclusion and Invitation Allianza is in production with all functionalities validated. We invite the developer community to analyze our architecture and give us technical feedback. Resources for Developers: • Technical Validation (Proofs and Implementation): https://www.allianza.tech/technical-validation • Technical Whitepaper: https://www.allianza.tech/whitepaper • Source Code: https://github.com/allianzatech/blockchainallianza What are your thoughts on the need for Triple Structural Redundancy in a post-quantum environment?
